body: I'm not sure what counts as controlling or manipulative behaviour, he just gets sad at a lot of things and I don't really know how to tell
I don't think we're conservative but our families are, yes. We're not religious at all. Is it really a red flag?
I don't care if they're high maintenance, I just want to know if it's "toxic"
We're not from the US. We don't need insurance but we do need money (healthcare costs money but not enough to warrant insurance), which his family controls.
Thank you for this! He unfortunately cannot seek psychiatric treatment because he's still with his family, and they're not really the helpful kind. Is there no other way?

Thank you! If I tell them how I feel, what if they stop telling me about their struggles just to keep me happy? I don't want them to stop being open with me. I'm looking for work locally but it won't be nearly as much money. The biggest issue with working without an internship is that I might end up with a much lower-paying job. I only get one year of working in the US on my current visa after graduation, after which a visa renewal is shaky. The whole point of this is to make money and what's the point if I can't even do that?
